guard: Both native Linux archives reach the PR pack and qualified cold candidate; release publication consumes that candidate through the secure preflight

mutations.name: PR pack drops the arm64 builder from needs
mutations.find:
seat-pack:
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' }}
    name: seat pack (assembled)
    timeout-minutes: 20
    needs: [seat-native-linux-x64, seat-native-linux-arm64, workspace-native]
mutations.replace:
seat-pack:
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' }}
    name: seat pack (assembled)
    timeout-minutes: 20
    needs: [seat-native-linux-x64, workspace-native]
mutations.expectRed: ci.yml seat-pack needs both native linux builders
mutations.cell: ci.yml seat-pack needs both native linux builders

mutations.name: PR pack stops downloading the arm64 artifact
mutations.find:
- uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: seat-native-linux-arm64
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/seat-native-linux-arm64
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: seat-native-darwin-*
mutations.expectRed: ci.yml seat-pack downloads both native linux artifacts
mutations.cell: ci.yml seat-pack downloads both native linux artifacts

mutations.name: PR pack stops calling the shared pack assembler
mutations.expectRed: ci.yml seat-pack runs the shared seat pack assembler
mutations.cell: ci.yml seat-pack runs the shared seat pack assembler

mutations.name: Cold candidate drops the native builder dependency
mutations.expectRed: cold candidate needs the native builder matrix
mutations.cell: cold candidate needs the native builder matrix

mutations.name: Cold candidate drops the arm64 artifact
mutations.expectRed: cold candidate downloads both native artifacts
mutations.cell: cold candidate downloads both native artifacts

mutations.name: Cold candidate skips native assembly
mutations.expectRed: cold candidate assembles natives before packing
mutations.cell: cold candidate assembles natives before packing

mutations.name: Changesets version job drops the npm-publish Environment
mutations.expectRed: changesets.yml version job is bound to the npm-publish Environment
mutations.cell: changesets.yml version job is bound to the npm-publish Environment

mutations.name: Changesets snapshot job drops the npm-publish Environment
mutations.expectRed: changesets.yml snapshot job is bound to the npm-publish Environment
mutations.cell: changesets.yml snapshot job is bound to the npm-publish Environment

mutations.name: ci.yml x64 builder uploads only peercred.node
mutations.expectRed: ci.yml seat-native-linux-x64 uploads the whole linux-x64/ directory (peercred.node and pty.node)
mutations.cell: ci.yml seat-native-linux-x64 uploads the whole linux-x64/ directory (peercred.node and pty.node)

mutations.name: ci.yml arm64 builder uploads only peercred.node
mutations.expectRed: ci.yml seat-native-linux-arm64 uploads the whole linux-arm64/ directory (peercred.node and pty.node)
mutations.cell: ci.yml seat-native-linux-arm64 uploads the whole linux-arm64/ directory (peercred.node and pty.node)

mutations.name: changesets.yml x64 builder uploads only peercred.node
mutations.expectRed: changesets.yml seat-native-linux-x64 uploads the whole linux-x64/ directory (peercred.node and pty.node)
mutations.cell: changesets.yml seat-native-linux-x64 uploads the whole linux-x64/ directory (peercred.node and pty.node)

mutations.name: changesets.yml arm64 builder uploads only peercred.node
mutations.expectRed: changesets.yml seat-native-linux-arm64 uploads the whole linux-arm64/ directory (peercred.node and pty.node)
mutations.cell: changesets.yml seat-native-linux-arm64 uploads the whole linux-arm64/ directory (peercred.node and pty.node)

mutations.name: ci.yml arm64 builder drops the symbol-version ceiling
mutations.find:
- name: Native symbol-version ceiling
        run: node packages/seat/scripts/assert-native-ceiling.mjs
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: seat-native-linux-arm64
mutations.expectRed: ci.yml seat-native-linux-arm64 enforces the native symbol-version ceiling before upload
mutations.cell: ci.yml seat-native-linux-arm64 enforces the native symbol-version ceiling before upload

mutations.name: PR pack names one native file instead of the builder directory
mutations.expectRed: SEAT_NATIVE_X64 and SEAT_NATIVE_ARM64 name the builder directory, not one file
mutations.cell: SEAT_NATIVE_X64 and SEAT_NATIVE_ARM64 name the builder directory, not one file

mutations.name: ARM load job stops running the pinned PTY probe
mutations.expectRed: ci.yml seat-linux-arm64 runs the pinned PTY load probe against the installed tarball
mutations.cell: ci.yml seat-linux-arm64 runs the pinned PTY load probe against the installed tarball
